scope: One source-exposed baseline diagnostic, six new questions across three immutable repositories. No candidate or blind quality claim.
order: Warm each fresh owned workspace using a non-frozen sentinel. Issue all six primaries before any deep/scoped or label-guided requests. Then issue deep/scoped per case. No question repetition beyond these frozen page roles.
providers: Hosted and local model ranking off, embeddings off, precision off, offline model envs; ordinary lexical/body/auto producer unchanged.
capture: Durably mark question issued before gateway request; preserve RAW envelopes before validation, stage ranks, selected identities, source-coordinate policies, exact Git/engine/origin before and after, partial records and owned cleanup.
labels: File presence, enclosing span and literal quote are separate automatic metrics. Manual source-bound assessment of complete requested guard/effect and equivalent answers controls actionable misses. Labels are non-exhaustive; no answer-quality inference from a file hit alone.

eligibility.mechanism: At least two misses in two repos attributable to the same distinct, previously untested mechanism; exclude all closed historical hypotheses.
eligibility.outcome_if_ineligible: Close with bounded diagnosis and continue release reconciliation.
eligibility.outcome_if_eligible: Write a separate prospective experiment design with causal, no-loss, development/holdout and latency gates. Do not implement a candidate under this plan.

retry: No automatic scored retry, tuning or old-question reuse; partial requests remain consumed. Infrastructure-only correction allowed only if zero real queries were issued.
reserved_holdout: Existing 24 unissued questions stay unissued and are not pilot inputs.
prelaunch: Independent semantic freshness/source/pin/protocol review and prospective online controls for materially new harness paths required before any frozen query.
